headline: Mooring and Weathered Lines See Fresh Shifts
war_summary: The latest ledger finds the war’s movement concentrated on two battered sectors. Weathered Expanse has changed materially since the previous edition, now showing one Warden, six Colonial, and two neutral bases, with 86 strategic-base events in 24 hours; its fighting remains intense, though only one event occurred in the last two hours. Mooring County has likewise lost a Warden-held base to neutrality, standing at nine Warden, two Colonial, and one neutral, while its daily activity has risen to 56 events and casualty rates are accelerating sharply. Marban Hollow remains unsettled, with 13 events and one Warden, six Colonial, and one neutral base. Callahan’s Passage has gone quiet at the base level after 16 events in the day, all ten positions presently Warden-held, while Nevish Line records 14 daily events but none in the latest two-hour window and retains seven Warden and one Colonial base. Gutter’s six-event ledger is unchanged and likewise quiet in the latest window. Elsewhere, Olavis Wake shows a fresh five-event burst, while most fronts report no recent base action.
